name: clean-model-names
goal: Shared type-only models keep their identities and use clean names across cards, usage links and detail headings.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Keep shared models with clean PascalCase names; preserve IDs, type filenames and classification. The selected model naming helper currently returns Deployment.types from its owned source.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standard explorer-name matrix explicitly expected Order.types. Existing browser cards only used runtime Order.ts. Extend that matrix and shared mixed-consumer fixture with a type collection and values companion; retain card, usage and detail checks at current and historical revisions. Generated instructions lacked logical model naming guidance.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Unchanged shared naming and three-viewport mixed-card matrix fails at 72386ab4: clean Order is required but Order.types is rendered. Record 08a641ea retains six before screenshots and 20 observations. Guidance assertions also reject missing instructions.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
